identification: Two cartons of Australiana books. Visible titles: Wool Past the Winning Post (Heather B. Ronald, history of the Chirnside family), The Grand Old Lady of Dandenong, The Glorious Years and The Restless Years (Jacaranda, 1968, O'Shaughnessy/Inson/Ward, large format with LP record), New Directions in Australian Architecture (Goad and Bingham-Hall), Helpmann the authorised biography (Elizabeth Salter, foreword Katharine Hepburn), The Wizard (hardback), Aboriginal Australians (Richard Broome), Sisters in Captivity, Kylie Naked, Bullwinkel, Gold legends, The Wonder of Little Things (Vince Copley), Sanders etc. Roughly 40 books, mostly common hardbacks and paperbacks.
